archetype: Hybrid: Archetype 2 (Performance Pro) + Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury). Deep Obsidian baseline with vivid neon accents tailored for an elite educational SaaS. Avoids generic AI UI slop.

background.description: Deep Obsidian/Midnight Blue. Never use pure black or generic gray.

surface.description: Flat, sharp surfaces with 1px subtle borders. Glassmorphism exclusively for top sticky navbar.

border.description: Crisp 1px borders to separate elements without using muddy drop shadows.

primary.description: Vivid Cyan for primary CTAs and active states.

navigation.sidebar: Fixed left, solid bg (#0C0F17), 1px right border (#1E2536). Active links use subtle Vivid Cyan left-border highlight.
navigation.topbar: Sticky top, crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-[#0A0D14]/70), 1px bottom border (#1E2536). Holds User Name, Avatar, Logout.

cards.style: Flat background (#11151F), max 8px border-radius (rounded-lg), 1px solid border (#1E2536), no default shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and soft glow.

tables.style: Widespread layout. Header row uppercase, tiny, wide-spaced. Subtle 1px bottom border per row. Hover state on rows changes bg slightly (bg-white/5).
tables.text_alignment: Left-aligned unless numeric data which should be right-aligned.

badges.style: Pill shape (rounded-full), px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium. Uses low opacity backgrounds with bright colored text and 1px border. Used for Status and Risk Levels.

buttons.primary: bg-[#00E5FF] text-[#0A0D14] font-semibold rounded-md px-6 py-2 transition-all hover:bg-[#33EEFF]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-[#1E2536] rounded-md px-6 py-2 transition-all hover:bg-[#1E2536]

inputs.style: bg-[#0A0D14] border border-[#1E2536] rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-white focus:border-[#00E5FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00E5FF] transition-all outline-none

loading_states.skeleton: Pulse animation with background color #1E2536 and rounded-md. Avoid simple generic gray boxes. Use skeletons that map directly to the shape of the content loading.

animations.hover: Button hover states explicitly define text color. Transition properties explicit (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease).
animations.page_transition: Micro-interactions on tab switching or plan generation. Avoid heavy motion.

auth_background.description: Dark textured architectural abstract for the login/register split-screen layout

user_avatar_placeholder.description: Placeholder professional student avatar for top navbar

testing.attributes: All interactive elements, inputs, form submissions, and major links MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn', data-testid='task-status-badge').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color hex codes provided in this guideline. Do not inject default generic gray palettes.
Implement the Layouts primarily using CSS Grid. Use the Bento/Control Room structure for the main dashboard metrics.
Do NOT use HTML `<input type='date'>` or native `<select>`. Rely entirely on customized Shadcn components (Calendar, Select, Form).
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide-react for the sidebar and metric icons.
Ensure the Risk Analysis card clearly uses the specified 'risk_levels' colors for background, text, and border.
Avoid the standard 'Bootstrap' look. Use 1px borders and distinct padding scales instead of muddy box-shadows.
